subject: general
question: Three of the following four letter-clusters are alike in some manner and hence form a group. Which letter-cluster does not belong to that group?
solution:
The logic followed here is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aa718dc3d80fa09b3eda3b7ebcb501ae0d35fbb68f85c6fcb0b5de22c71bf85f.png] 

**Logic:** First letter - 2 = Second letter; Second letter - 1 = Third letter

 
• **TSQ → T - 2 = S; S - 2 = Q**
 
• JHG → J - 2 = H; H - 1 = G
 
• PNM → P - 2 = N; N - 1 = M
 
• XVU → X - 2 = V; V - 1 = U

Hence, '**TSQ**' is the correct answer.
